battle.name: 大北方戰爭
battle.theater: 波羅的海東岸與波蘭南部
battle.brief: 一七〇〇年五月，查理十二世率瑞典軍越過波蘭邊界，大北方戰爭開打。這件野砲在戰爭裡是雙方野戰的骨幹：納爾瓦之戰，瑞典炮兵在暴雪中以霰彈把密集的俄軍縱列打成缺口；波爾塔瓦之戰，彼得一世的野砲佔據城北高地下壓射擊，決定了這場戰爭的勝負。

kit.name: 野砲
kit.history: 能拆成幾件馬車拉走的砲。它讓野戰第一次有了可以計算的砲火。

countries:
大北方戰爭是北歐與東歐兩套聯盟體系對撞的結果，交戰方分屬兩個鬆散而目標一致的集團。

北方同盟以瑞典帝國為核心：本土的瑞典王國與芬蘭、波羅的海各省（愛沙尼亞、利沃尼亞、英格利亞、卡累利阿）、波美拉尼亞、不來梅-費爾登，加上荷爾斯泰因-哥托普這個附庸國，都是查理的版圖。作戰指揮極度集中：國王查理十二世自任全軍最高統帥，戰場上絕大部分命令由他親自發出；斯德哥爾摩由軍政會議與軍械院掌兵員、糧秣與軍械，波羅的海各省總督只負責守城與徵召。查理的軍隊以卡羅里那式常備營為骨幹，入侵波蘭時約四萬五千人，靠強制徵召與徵兵制在二十一年裡不斷擴充。

北方同盟的外圍包括鄂圖曼帝國、克里米亞汗國，以及卡爾梅克與巴什基爾等草原部族；一七〇〇年連俄羅斯也站在瑞典一方，彼得一世在君士坦丁堡議定俄國保有亞速時，密約裡曾對瑞典作出友好的承諾。一七二〇年，普魯士與漢諾威為瓜分瑞典波美拉尼亞而加入北方同盟。

對面的大北方聯盟由俄羅斯、波蘭立陶宛聯邦、丹麥-挪威、薩克斯、普魯士與漢諾威組成，一七一六年奧地利參戰，一七一〇年鄂圖曼帝國因對俄開戰也站到聯盟一方。這個集團的指揮體系更鬆散：俄國以沙皇的戰爭會議為核心，彼得本人兼最高統帥與炮兵總監；波蘭方面由奧古斯特二世率薩克森軍，本國國會與地方民兵則自成一套；丹麥與荷蘭主要靠海軍與外國補助作戰。英格蘭與荷蘭共和國不派主力部隊，只以現金貸給俄國——荷蘭商人借款給彼得造船，荷蘭船匠在聖彼得堡附近的船上工廠裡造炮艦。
countriesEn:
The Great Northern War was the result of two alliance systems in northern and eastern Europe colliding, and the belligerents split into two loose groupings with a single shared purpose.

The Northern Alliance was built on the Swedish Empire: the Swedish kingdom proper and Finland, the Baltic provinces (Estonia, Livonia, Ingria and Karelia), Pomerania, Bremen-Verden, and the client duchy of Holstein-Gottorp were all Charles's territories. Command was extremely concentrated: King Charles XII was supreme commander of the whole army, and on the battlefield the great majority of orders came from his own mouth; in Stockholm the war council and the ordnance office handled men, supply and matériel, while the governors of the Baltic provinces were responsible only for the defence of towns and for recruitment. The backbone of Charles's army was the carolean regiment: about forty-five thousand men at the invasion of Poland, expanded continuously over twenty-one years by forced levy and conscription.

Around the Northern Alliance stood the Ottoman Empire, the Crimean Khanate and the steppe peoples such as the Kalmyks and the Bashkirs; in 1700 even Russia stood on the Swedish side, and when Peter I settled at Constantinople that Russia would keep Azov, the secret articles of the treaty containing friendly promises to Sweden. In 1720 Prussia and Hanover joined the Northern Alliance so that they could share out Swedish Pomerania.

Opposite them was the Great Northern Alliance of Russia, the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, Denmark-Norway, Saxony, Prussia and Hanover; Austria came in in 1716, and in 1710 the Ottoman Empire, having gone to war with Russia, also stood on the alliance side. This grouping was commanded even more loosely: in Russia the core was the tsar's war council, with Peter himself both supreme commander and master of the artillery; in Poland Augustus II led the Saxon army while the country's Sejm and local militias formed a system of their own; Denmark and the Dutch relied on their fleets and on foreign subsidies. England and the Dutch Republic put no main bodies into the field but supplied cash to Russia — Dutch merchants lent Peter money to build ships, and Dutch shipwrights worked in the shipyards near Saint Petersburg.
people:
決定這場戰爭走向的是十幾個人。

瑞典這邊，國王查理十二世自一六九七年登基到一七一八年去世，二十一多半的戰爭都由他帶著一支縱隊在歐亞大陸內陸移動。他自幼喜好砲術，對野砲與攻城砲的射程、射速與車架極為熟悉，也因此把瑞典砲兵拆成貼近步兵的營屬三磅砲與獨立的軍屬砲隊兩級。一七〇九年波爾塔瓦慘敗後，他沒有投降也沒有回國，反而拖著殘軍又打了七年。一七一六年十二月，他在斯德哥爾摩病逝，年三十四。

他的左右手是工程與軍械總監埃里克·達爾貝里，掌管瑞典全部攻城砲兵與野砲的技術事務，一七〇一年里加圍城與一七〇八至一七〇九年納爾瓦圍城的砲壘都是他的手筆；馬格努斯·尤利烏斯·勒文豪普特是負責殿後的宿將，一七〇八年十月在列加河下游遭殲，次年六月在納爾瓦附近戰死；卡爾·古斯塔夫·雷恩斯基爾德接過兵符，在芬蘭南部一連取勝，保障查理殘軍退回本土。

俄羅斯這邊，彼得一世在納爾瓦以一名普通軍官的身分親歷敗績，此後把全部心力放在軍制上：一七〇一年設炮兵學校，一七〇二年建炮兵團，一七〇五年前後清查人口、按戶抽丁，他親自到射擊場與兵營視事。戰場上他倚重博里索·舍列梅提夫的騎兵、阿尼克雷·列普寧的前衛與亞歷山大·門希科夫；海軍交給戈洛文伯爵與阿普拉克辛，一七一四年古格特海戰就是這條線上的成果。

波蘭與薩克斯方面，奧古斯特二世在逃亡數年後重奪王位，卻再未真正掌權；被查理扶上位的斯坦尼斯瓦夫·萊什琴斯基淪為傀儡。鄂圖曼方面，艾哈邁德三世蘇丹輕信宰相達馬特·易卜拉欣帕夏的鼓動，一七一一年御駕親征普魯特河，反被大維齊爾陣亡與自己被俘所拖累；克里米亞可汗德夫列特二世亦在戰役中出力甚多。另有普魯士國王腓特烈一世與漢諾威選帝喬治一世在末局入局，以及在普魯特河後統率俄軍的日耳曼裔將領穆尼希。
peopleEn:
A dozen-odd men decided how this war went.

On the Swedish side, King Charles XII reigned from 1697 until his death in 1718, and for more than twenty of the war's years he led a single column across the interior of Eurasia. He had been fond of artillery from boyhood, was intimately familiar with the range, rate of fire and carriage of field and siege guns, and it was he who split Swedish artillery into the three-pounder regimental guns attached to the infantry and the independent army artillery. After the disaster of Poltava in 1709 he neither surrendered nor went home, and dragged what was left of his army into seven more years of war. He died in Stockholm in December 1716, at thirty-four.

His right-hand men were Erik Dahlbergh, director of the engineers and of the ordnance, who held technical control of all Swedish siege artillery and field guns and whose work was the artillery works at the siege of Riga in 1701 and at the siege of Narva in 1708 and 1709; and Magnus Julius Lewenhaupt, the veteran who conducted the rearguards, annihilated on the lower Luga in October 1708 and killed near Narva the following June. Carl Gustaf Rehnskiöld took over the command, won a string of actions in southern Finland and covered the retreat of Charles's remnant home to Sweden.

On the Russian side, Peter I had tasted defeat at Narva as an ordinary officer, and from then on put all his energy into the army: a school of artillery in 1701, the first artillery regiments in 1702, a reckoning of the population and a levy by household around 1705, with the tsar himself inspecting the shooting ground and the barracks. In the field he relied on the cavalry of Boris Sheremetev, the advanced guard of Anikrey Repnin and Alexander Menshikov; at sea he left matters to Count Golovin and Apraksin, and the victory at Gangut in 1714 was the fruit of that line of work.

In Poland and Saxony, Augustus II recovered his throne after years of exile but never really held power again; Stanisław Leszczyński, whom Charles had put on the throne, remained a puppet. On the Ottoman side Sultan Ahmed III was led astray by his grand vizier Damat Ibrahim Pasha, rode out in person against the Pruth in 1711, and was undone by the death of his vizier and his own capture; the Crimean Khan Devlet II Giray also put substantial effort into the campaign. Prince Frederick I of Prussia and George I of Hanover entered in the closing phase, as did the German-born Russian commander von Münnich, who led the Russian army after the Pruth.
kits:
這件野砲的原型是十六世紀西班牙系統的野戰砲：青銅滑膛、鐵箍加固、以數匹馬的雙套車拉行，與更重的攻城砲分開編列。十八世紀初，它在大北方戰爭裡的位置已經明確：野砲是各軍的火力骨幹，攻城砲則是另一套更笨重、更費錢的系統。

瑞典方面，野砲由工程與軍械總監埃里克·達爾貝里統管。步兵營按營配屬三磅營屬砲，砲組隨行前線，隨裝藥與霰彈的備件車同行，射速約每分鐘兩到三發；軍屬砲隊配六磅、十二磅與二十四磅，負責會戰中的正面火力與追擊。一七〇一年里加圍城和後來的納爾瓦圍城都用上成排的攻城砲與臼砲，砲數以數百門計。

俄國這邊是彼得親手改造的。十七世紀末俄軍的火砲分散在各地城堡，沒有統一編制與射擊條例；彼得在一七〇一年設立炮兵學校，一七〇二年組建第一批炮兵團，把火砲、射擊術與技術測量集中起來，並設計了獨角獸砲——以木製旋轉炮架承托的輕型六磅砲，砲身可繞軸三百六十度轉向，不必移動砲位就換射界。

除野砲之外，兩軍步兵都用燧發滑膛步槍、插座刺刀，齊射是基本動作；騎兵配燧發手槍與卡賓槍；圍城用臼砲、擲彈、地雷箱、坑道與柴束；糧秣靠大車、牛車與海運，冬季雪地行軍改用雪橇，渡河靠浮橋與臨時架設的便橋；俄國在里加灣與維堡灣以加萊戰艦巡弋，這是彼得用荷蘭貸款與船匠在聖彼得堡造出來的。
kitsEn:
The prototype of this field gun was the field piece of the sixteenth-century Spanish system: bronze, smooth-bored, reinforced with iron hoops, drawn on a two-horse team of several horses, and kept in separate establishment from the heavier siege guns. By the early eighteenth century its place in the Great Northern War was already settled: the field gun was the firepower backbone of every army, while siege artillery had become a heavier and far more expensive system of its own.

On the Swedish side the field guns were under Erik Dahlbergh as director of the engineers and the ordnance. Each infantry company carried a three-pounder regimental gun, its crew marching in the front line and its limber and ammunition wagon travelling with it, at a rate of fire of roughly two to three rounds a minute; the army artillery had six-, twelve- and twenty-four-pounders, responsible for the frontal fire of the battle and for the pursuit. The siege of Riga in 1701 and the later siege of Narva employed batteries of siege guns and mortars, the numbers running into the hundreds.

On the Russian side the change was Peter's own work. At the end of the seventeenth century Russian guns were scattered in the castles of the provinces, without unified establishment or any common system of shooting; Peter founded a school of artillery in 1701, formed the first artillery regiments in 1702, brought guns, gunnery and technical measurement under one discipline, and designed the unicorn, a light six-pounder carried on a wooden revolving platform that let the piece traverse a full three hundred and sixty degrees without being moved from its position to change its arc of fire.

Apart from the field gun, the infantry of both armies used flintlock smoothbore muskets with socket bayonets, and volley fire was the basic action; the cavalry carried flintlock pistols and carbines; siege work used mortars, petards, powder charges for mining, saps and fascines; supply moved on great wagons, ox carts and by sea, with sledges used for winter marching and pontoon or improvised bridges for river crossings. Russia patrolled the Gulf of Riga and the Gulf of Viborg with galleys, craft built at Saint Petersburg with Dutch loans and Dutch shipwrights.
tactics:
瑞典的戰法是行軍戰：查理十二世拒絕在對方划得來的條件下打會戰，寧可帶一支精銳縱隊在雪地裡長距離行軍，用速度與突然性去啃對手的縱深。

一七〇〇年十一月三十日納爾瓦是這一風格的樣本。俄軍沿納爾瓦河擺成雙層凹形，試圖以中央縱隊直衝瑞典軍正面；暴雪掩護了瑞典軍的接近，瑞典步兵在百步之內以霰彈對密集的俄軍縱列齊射，隨即以刺刀與騎兵衝鋒近戰，俄軍兩翼被擊潰，彼得本人落荒而逃。

一七〇七年二月洪梅爾霍夫之戰與同年圍攻施泰丁，瑞典以同樣的辦法打散薩克森-普魯士的解援部隊。轉入俄國戰線後，瑞典的長處變成弱點：一七〇八年冬天，縱隊在雪原上缺糧缺薪，凍餓死者以千計；一七〇九年八月十九日沃爾斯克拉河戰役，彼得的前衛在強渡中的縱隊側後打擊，把瑞典的攻勢打回。

波爾塔瓦是俄國把技術優勢用盡的一役：彼得把主力配置在城北高地上築壘塹，野砲居高臨下，以霰彈向密集的瑞典縱隊傾瀉；瑞典縱隊被地形切成數段，輜重車隊與退路被切斷，最後在城北小溪一線崩潰，國王本人中彈。俄軍步兵靠營內齊射、縱深配置與第二線預備隊的及時投入取勝，此後俄軍的操典與歐洲各國的線性射擊制度幾乎同出一源。

晚年的俄軍還有別的手段：一七一〇年起利用冰封的河流冬季渡河，一七一一年在普魯特河被鄂圖曼與克里米亞聯軍合圍，一七一四年以加萊戰艦封鎖維堡灣並在古格特取勝。整體而言，這場戰爭把集中使用野砲、線性齊射與縱深預備隊定成十八世紀歐陸軍隊的標準樣式。
tacticsEn:
The Swedish way of war was a war of movement: Charles XII refused to fight a pitched battle on ground of the opponent's choosing, and preferred to march a picked column a long way over the snow, chewing on the enemy's depth with speed and surprise.

Narva on 30 November 1700 was the model of that style. The Russians drew up in a double line concave to the river, trying to drive their central column straight at the Swedish front; a snowstorm covered the Swedish approach, the Swedish infantry fired canister at point-blank range into the massed Russian columns, and then closed in with bayonet and cavalry, the Russian wings being routed and Peter himself riding off the field.

The battle of Hummelhoff in February 1707 and the siege of Stettin in the same year broke up the Saxon-Prussian relieving force by the same means. Once the war moved into Russia the Swedish strength became a weakness: in the winter of 1708 the column lacked food and pay in the snow, and thousands died of cold and hunger; at the battle of the Vorskla on 19 August 1709 Peter's advanced guard struck the flank of the column as it forced the river, and drove the Swedish attack back.

Poltava was the battle in which Russia used its technical advantage to the full: Peter posted his main body on the heights north of the town, dug in, and let the field guns pour canister down onto the packed Swedish columns; the Swedish columns were cut into separate pieces by the ground, their baggage train and line of retreat were severed, and at last they broke on a small stream north of the town, the king himself being hit. Russian infantry won by volleys inside the battalion, by depth in the line and by the timely entry of the second-line reserve, and from then on Russian drill and the linear system of shooting in Europe had a common source.

The later Russian army had other devices as well: from 1710 it used frozen rivers for winter crossings, in 1711 it was surrounded on the Pruth by the Ottoman and Crimean armies, and in 1714 it blockaded the Gulf of Viborg with galleys and won at Gangut. Taken as a whole, the war fixed the concentrated use of field guns, linear volley fire and depth reserves as the standard of continental armies in the eighteenth century.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下。戰爭自一七〇〇年五月查理十二世越過波蘭邊界起，到一七二一年八月三十日《尼斯塔德條約》生效為止，前後二十一年。兵員：瑞典陸軍在入侵波蘭時約四萬五千人，戰爭高峰時連各省守備與民兵在內約十萬人上下；俄軍可用兵力由一七〇〇年的約十萬增至一七〇九年波爾塔瓦時野戰部隊約四萬五千至八萬人。會戰：納爾瓦一七〇〇年十一月三十日，瑞典約九千人（含援軍約一萬二千至一萬三千），俄軍約三萬至四萬人，俄軍陣亡約八千至九千人、被俘約一萬五千人，瑞典損失不足五百人；洪梅爾霍夫一七〇七年二月，瑞典約九千人對薩克森-普魯士聯軍約一萬二千至一萬三千人，聯軍損失約三千人；沃爾斯克拉河一七〇九年八月十九日，俄軍約二萬五千至三萬人，損失逾一萬人、被俘數千，瑞典損失約八百至一千人；波爾塔瓦一七〇九年六月二十七日，瑞典在戰場約一萬九千至二萬三千人，損失約七千至九千人（陣亡、受傷與被俘），俄軍損失約一千五百至四千人。圍城：里加圍城歷時數月，納爾瓦圍城自一七〇八年十一月至一七〇九年六月約七個月，波爾塔瓦圍城自一七〇九年五月至六月約兩個月。砲兵：納爾瓦城下俄軍攻城火炮以數百門計，瑞典一方的野砲與攻城砲合計約三百門上下。海上：古格特海戰一七一四年七月二十七日，俄軍二十七艘（其中加萊戰艦十二艘）對瑞典約十九艘，俄軍奪獲十一艘、擊毀四艘。普魯特河一七一一年七月十八日，俄軍約三萬至四萬人被鄂圖曼約六萬至十萬人與克里米亞騎兵約四萬至五萬人包圍。距離與補給：瑞典縱隊自波羅的海東岸行軍約八百公里抵莫斯科城下，敗後自波爾塔瓦退向第聶伯河渡口約三百公里，途中因缺糧與追擊再損數千人。割地：《尼斯塔德條約》下瑞典交出愛沙尼亞、利沃尼亞、英格利亞、卡累利阿與波美拉尼亞南部，芬蘭大部歸還俄國。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run roughly as follows. The war is counted from May 1700, when Charles XII crossed the Polish frontier, to the entry into force of the Treaty of Nystad on 30 August 1721, a matter of twenty-one years. Manpower: the Swedish army numbered about forty-five thousand men at the invasion of Poland and, at the height of the war, about one hundred thousand counting provincial garrisons and militias; Russian available forces grew from roughly one hundred thousand in 1700 to between forty-five thousand and eighty thousand in the field at Poltava in 1709. Battles: at Narva on 30 November 1700 the Swedes had about nine thousand men (some twelve to thirteen thousand with reinforcements) against thirty to forty thousand Russians, the Russians losing about eight to nine thousand dead and some fifteen thousand prisoners while the Swedish loss was under five hundred; at Hummelhoff in February 1707 about nine thousand Swedes met a Saxon-Prussian relieving force of twelve to thirteen thousand, the allies losing about three thousand; at the Vorskla on 19 August 1709 twenty-five to thirty thousand Russians lost more than ten thousand men, several thousand of them prisoners, against a Swedish loss of some eight hundred to a thousand; at Poltava on 27 June 1709 the Swedes had between nineteen and twenty-three thousand men on the field and lost about seven to nine thousand, killed, wounded or captured, against fifteen hundred to four thousand for the Russians. Sieges: the siege of Riga lasted a number of months, the siege of Narva from November 1708 to June 1709 about seven months, the siege of Poltava from May to June 1709 about two months. Artillery: the Russian siege train before Narva ran into the hundreds of guns, while the Swedish field and siege pieces together came to about three hundred. At sea, in the battle of Gangut on 27 July 1714 twenty-seven Russian ships, of them twelve galleys, met about nineteen Swedish vessels, the Russians taking eleven and burning four. On the Pruth on 18 July 1711 thirty to forty thousand Russians were surrounded by sixty to a hundred thousand Ottomans and forty to fifty thousand Crimean horsemen. Distances and supply: the Swedish column marched some eight hundred kilometres from the eastern Baltic to the walls of Moscow, and after Poltava about three hundred kilometres from the field of Poltava towards the Dnieper crossings, losing several thousand men more on the way for want of food and from the pursuit. Cessions: under the Treaty of Nystad Sweden gave up Estonia, Livonia, Ingria, Karelia and the southern part of Pomerania, and the greater part of Finland was returned to Russia.
cause:
打起來的根子有四層。

第一層是波羅的海的均勢。俄羅斯在南方打完亞速戰役，又在一六九七至一六九八年派大使團走遍西歐，彼得一世看得很清楚：沒有波羅的海的海口，俄国就是內陸國家，沒有海軍就沒有南方屏障。一六九九年俄軍第二次攻打亞速，瑞典派出的援軍雖在納爾瓦被彼得打散，但彼得已把出海的目標擺到了桌面上。

第二層是荷爾斯泰因-哥托普。這個公國與瑞典王室有姻親關係，卻夾在丹麥與勃蘭登堡之間；丹麥國王腓特烈四世在荷蘭的支援下插手，瑞典視為不可容忍的侵犯。雙方在特勞芬達爾條約裡短暫妥協，但積怨未消。

第三層是波蘭王位。奧古斯特二世是薩克斯選侯兼波蘭國王，他利用歐洲普遍敵視法國的聯盟取得王位；法國與瑞典各扶一個波蘭國王，戰爭因此有了看似可控的有限目標，卻也因此無法收場。查理十二世於一七〇四年扶斯坦尼斯瓦夫·萊什琴斯基登位，藉此逼奧古斯特退位。

第四層是查理本人與彼得的身分之爭。查理少年得志，自視為歐洲軍事的最高仲裁者，不肯承認彼得是對等的君主；彼得則堅持以皇帝的名號與俄國的實力相爭。仲裁會議屢次失敗：阿爾特蘭施塔特、烏得勒支與海牙的會談裡，查理寧可再打一場也不肯接受條款，彼得寧可加稅重整軍制也不肯退讓。於是本可用外交收尾的邊界問題，變成一場二十一年的消耗戰。
causeEn:
The roots of the conflict lie on four levels.

The first is the balance in the Baltic. Having fought the campaign for Azov in the south and sent an embassy across western Europe between 1697 and 1698, Peter I saw the matter plainly: without a port on the Baltic Russia was a land power, and without a navy it had no southern shield. The second Russian attempt on Azov in 1699 was beaten off, and the Swedish relief was scattered at Narva, but Peter had by then put the question of access to the sea on the table.

The second is Holstein-Gottorp. The duchy was bound to the Swedish dynasty by marriage yet lay between Denmark and Brandenburg, and King Frederick IV of Denmark, with Dutch support, meddled in it; Sweden treated this as an intolerable violation. The two reached a short-lived compromise in the Treaty of Travendal, but the grudge survived.

The third is the Polish crown. Augustus II was Elector of Saxony as well as king of Poland, and had taken the throne on the strength of the general European hostility to France; France and Sweden each backed a different Polish king, so the war began with a limited and apparently manageable aim, and for that very reason could not be closed. In 1704 Charles XII put Stanisław Leszczyński on the Polish throne, using it to force Augustus to abdicate.

The fourth is the clash of rank between Charles himself and Peter. Charles, who had come to the throne young, regarded himself as the highest arbiter of European war and would not recognise Peter as an equal sovereign; Peter insisted on the title of emperor and on the strength to back it. Arbitration failed repeatedly: at Altranstädt, at Utrecht and at The Hague Charles would rather fight another battle than accept terms, and Peter would rather tax and reform his army than give way. A frontier dispute that might have been closed by diplomacy thus became a war of attrition lasting twenty-one years.
impact:
影響是重排了北歐的權力次序。

第一，俄國從內陸國家變成波羅的海強權。一七〇三年建彼得堡，一七二一年受封皇帝，北方同盟解體時它拿走了這場戰爭最大的一份戰利品：整個波羅的海東岸的海口、航路與出海口。俄國的軍制也在這場戰爭裡脫胎換骨——最早按戶抽丁的常備軍、按營編制的炮兵、炮兵學校與技術測量制度、線性射擊與縱深預備隊的操典，這一套後來被腓特烈二世整批抄去，再由普魯士傳遍全歐。為了供養軍隊與船廠，稅負加重、鹽專賣與造幣廠相繼設立。

第二，瑞典的帝國時代結束。失去波羅的海各省之後，瑞典退回本土與芬蘭，王室財政枯竭、軍隊裁減，一七一八年查理十二世之死與其後的總監政府開啟了瑞典的自由時代。瑞典的戰術卻贏得了聲譽：輕野砲、步兵營屬砲與騎兵的協同、嚴格的操練，被各國軍校逐一研究；但失去的波羅的海各省無法靠名聲抵銷。

第三，波蘭立陶宛聯邦被打殘。奧古斯特二世於一七〇九年收復王位，但薩克森軍長期駐境，聯邦財政崩潰，薩克森兵與聯邦議會的衝突，把這個貴族共和國推向更深的分裂，此後瓜分的三次刀口正是在這一戰之後拉開的。

第四，奧地利與鄂圖曼的平衡被打破。奧地利趁一七一六至一七一八年的戰役拿下塞爾維亞與巴爾幹的一角，開始設立邊防區，帝國從此有了通向東方的一條陸路；鄂圖曼則在亞速、普魯特與帕薩羅維茨三役之後元氣大傷，克里米亞汗國也淪為附庸。北歐五國在這一戰後的版圖是：俄國得波羅的海東岸，瑞典得瑞典與芬蘭，普魯士得施泰丁與波美拉尼亞南部，丹麥保住荷爾斯泰因-哥托普的宗主權並退出戰爭，漢諾威從瑞典手裡買下不來梅-費爾登。英國與荷蘭不動一兵一卒，只用錢和船改了變局。
impactEn:
The effects amounted to a reordering of power in the north.

First, Russia turned from a land power into a Baltic power. St Petersburg was founded in 1703 and the tsar was crowned emperor in 1721, and when the Northern Alliance came apart Russia took the largest share of the spoils: the harbours, the sea lanes and the outlets of the whole eastern Baltic shore. The Russian army was also refitted in this war — a standing army levied by household, artillery organised by company, a school of artillery and a discipline of technical measurement, linear shooting and reserves in depth — and that whole package was later copied wholesale by Frederick II and carried from Prussia across Europe. To feed the army and the shipyards, taxation was raised and the salt monopoly and the mint were put under new management.

Second, the Swedish imperial age ended. After the loss of the Baltic provinces Sweden fell back on the kingdom proper and Finland, the royal finances ran dry and the army was cut; the death of Charles XII in 1718 and the regency that followed opened the age of liberty in Sweden. Swedish tactics nevertheless gained a reputation: light field guns, the regimental gun working with the infantry, cavalry cooperation and strict drill, all studied one by one in the war colleges of Europe; but the Baltic provinces could not be offset by reputation.

Third, the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth was left broken. Augustus II recovered his throne in 1709, but the Saxon army remained on the ground for years, the Commonwealth's finances collapsed, and the friction between Saxon soldiers and the Sejm drove the noble republic deeper into division, and the three knives of the later partition were drawn open after this very war.

Fourth, the balance between Austria and the Ottomans was broken. Austria took Serbia and a corner of the Balkans in the campaigns of 1716 to 1718 and began to establish a military frontier, so that the Empire acquired a land road to the East; the Ottomans, after Azov, the Pruth and Passarowitz, were badly shaken, and the Crimean Khanate sank into the status of a vassal. The map of the five northern powers after the war was this: Russia with the eastern Baltic shore, Sweden with Sweden and Finland, Prussia with Stettin and the southern part of Pomerania, Denmark keeping its overlordship over Holstein-Gottorp and leaving the war, Hanover buying Bremen-Verden from Sweden. England and the Dutch moved no troops at all and changed the situation with money and shipping alone.
result:
結果是一份把北歐重新分完的分割。

一七二一年八月三十日《尼斯塔德條約》由俄國與瑞典在芬蘭南部簽訂：瑞典割讓愛沙尼亞、利沃尼亞、英格利亞、卡累利阿與波美拉尼亞南部，保留芬蘭大部，但維堡與克斯霍爾姆仍歸俄國；俄軍退出芬蘭，北歐的戰線就此關閉。同期的小國條約把剩下的帳結清：一七一九年瑞典私下把不來梅-費爾登賣給漢諾威，一七二〇年七月《腓特烈斯堡條約》讓丹麥退出戰爭並保住荷爾斯泰因-哥托普的宗主權，同年十一月《斯德哥爾摩條約》分別與普魯士、漢諾威瓜分波美拉尼亞，一七一八年七月的《帕薩羅維茨條約》讓奧地利與鄂圖曼在巴爾幹劃界，一七一一年七月普魯特河一役的《普魯特條約》則把亞速交回鄂圖曼並把黑海東岸的大門關上。戰爭的殘餘到一七二二年才完全收尾。

從兵器看，這件十六世紀的野砲走完了它的全程：一七〇九年波爾塔瓦決定戰局的，是俄軍在城北高地上集中起來的野砲；此後十八世紀的野砲不再是一門砲，而是每千人四到六門的密度、三六十二磅的分級與貼在步兵身後的營屬砲這三件事的制度。從軍制看，這場戰爭把野砲、線性齊射與縱深預備隊定成歐陸軍隊的通用樣式，把強制徵兵制下的常備軍推到數十萬人的規模，也把火藥、炮車、馬匹與糧秣的生產推成國家最重的開支。從政治看，這場戰爭把北歐的話語權從瑞典交到俄國手裡，把波蘭推向瓜分，把奧地利推向巴爾幹，把鄂圖曼推向衰退——此後一百年的歐洲秩序，都在這二十一年裡定了型。
resultEn:
The result was a partition that divided the north once more.

The Treaty of Nystad was signed by Russia and Sweden in southern Finland on 30 August 1721: Sweden ceded Estonia, Livonia, Ingria, Karelia and the southern part of Pomerania, keeping the greater part of Finland, though Viborg and Kexholm went to Russia; the Russian army withdrew from Finland and the northern front closed. The smaller treaties settled the rest of the account at the same time: in 1719 Sweden sold Bremen-Verden to Hanover in secret, in July 1720 the Treaty of Frederiksborg took Denmark out of the war with its overlordship over Holstein-Gottorp intact, and in November of the same year the Treaties of Stockholm divided Pomerania with Prussia and Hanover, the Treaty of Passarowitz of July 1718 drew the line in the Balkans between Austria and the Ottomans, and the Treaty of the Pruth of July 1711 gave Azov back to the Ottomans and shut the door on the eastern Black Sea. The last embers of the war did not die out until 1722.

As for weapons, the field gun of the sixteenth century ran the whole of its course here: what decided Poltava in 1709 was the mass of Russian field guns on the heights north of the town; and the field gun of the eighteenth century was thereafter no longer a single piece but a system of three things — a density of four to six guns per thousand men, a classification in three-, six- and twelve-pounders, and the regimental gun carried in the infantry's own column. As for the armies, the war fixed field gun, linear volley and reserve in depth as the common form of continental armies, pushed the conscript standing army to a size of several hundred thousand men, and made powder, gun carriages, horses and food the heaviest expenditure of the state. As for politics, the war handed the lead in the north from Sweden to Russia, pushed Poland towards partition, pushed Austria towards the Balkans and pushed the Ottoman Empire into decline; the order of Europe for the century that followed was shaped in these twenty-one years.
